variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, wants the wolves driven off from his ram Bartle and his fold.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Please, help me, kind stranger! The wolves have broken into my fold and my poor ram, Bartle, is trapped by them in the far pen!

Drive them off and you'll have my thanks forever!

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Any pelts you find out there you may keep! Just hurry and save Bartle!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text:
Hooray, you saved him! How can I ever thank you for such bravery?!

What's that you say? Gold, and plenty of it? Well, if gold it must be, please take this as a sign of my gratitude.

journal.text: Save Bartle the Ram from wolves at the edge of the Ashwood.

variants.specifics: Skarn Delve: Paymaster Orrin offers a bounty on Skrit, the king of the Imps raiding the ore carts

offer.speaker: Paymaster Orrin
offer.text:
Hello, young sir. I surmise you have come about the bounty.

There is a generous reward on Skrit the Imp King -- dead or alive. He and his noisy swarm of Imps have been raiding the ore carts for weeks.

Take care, you do not want to get bitten by those spiteful pests.

reminder.speaker: Paymaster Orrin
reminder.text: Still no word on Skrit? The Imps are at the carts again!

completion.speaker: Paymaster Orrin
completion.text:
Ho, there! Nib complained of squeaking down this tunnel, so I came to look.

You have single handedly slain the dreaded Skrit! Very impressive! My profound respect is yours! Skrit's swarm has plagued Skarn Delve for weeks! I'll take it from here. We will all rest easier now that this vile pest is dead!

And here is your reward -- 100 in gold!

variants.specifics: Gorrow: Dorrit, whose ducks were dragged off from the hamlet of Tarn by Bog Gators, wants them driven out

offer.speaker: Dorrit
offer.text:
Sir! Please help me! A pack of foul Bog Gators just overran Tarn, the hamlet south of here and dragged off almost all of my ducks! One of them was my sweet Pru!

Please drive them out and I promise you a reward!

reminder.speaker: Dorrit
reminder.text: Oh why aren't you going? My poor ducks are in terrible danger!

completion.speaker: Dorrit
completion.text: Oh, thank you, brave sir! These are tokens of my gratitude!

journal.text: Drive the Bog Gators out of Tarn for Dorrit.

variants.specifics: Karth Vael: Commander Ostrag wants Grolm, the Troll chief who raided the Granary Yard, dead in the Troll Den on Mount Dreg.

offer.speaker: Ostrag
offer.text:
Blast! Where were you, lad!? The Trolls stormed the Granary Yard and we'd have lost the winter stores to them if Dorrik's pikemen had not charged in at the last moment!

But in the confusion, their chief Grolm got away with a dozen of our war-horses, leaving the burnt stores our smallest worry! All of Karth Vael is now at risk if Grolm lives!

You must follow his trail, northeast to the Troll Den on Mount Dreg! Kill Grolm or we are doomed!

reminder.speaker: Ostrag
reminder.text: I'm sure Grolm is still out there! Go quickly!

completion.speaker: Ostrag
completion.text:
In calmer times, the barracks of Karth Vael would ring with cheers for the death of Grolm! Well done! But now we must stop the Troll King Skorn once and for all.

Please accept these with our deepest thanks for your fine work!

journal.text: Go to the Troll Den and kill Grolm.

variants.specifics: Orlmere: Tamsk wants the river pirate Joh Skarn caught and the toll chest he stole brought back.

offer.speaker: Tamsk
offer.text: Ooooh, what is this? That pirate beat both of my ferrymen. There is no time to fetch the guards. Quickly, you must catch him before the toll chest goes into the lake.

reminder.speaker: Tamsk
reminder.text: Please, I'm begging you. Hunt down that thieving scoundrel and bring back the toll chest.

completion.speaker: Tamsk
completion.text: The toll chest is saved! Gurtle will need my Bow to guard it. Here, take both to him.

journal.text: Regain the toll chest stolen by the pirate Joh Skarn.

variants.specifics: Zorreth: Tessik, keeper of the Archive, wants the Imps and giant bats cleared from the vaults and his trapped clerks rescued.

offer.speaker: Tessik
offer.text:
Why are you so late!? We are in terrible trouble!

Vicious giant bats and Imps from the pit have overrun the vaults beneath the Archive. Several clerks have been lost protecting the college's precious books!

Please, we implore you! Drive the beasts from the vaults, rescue my clerks and I will pay you generously.

This key opens the gate to the first trapped clerk. He will lead you to the others.

I also have a spell book which ought to be very handy.

reminder.speaker: Tessik
reminder.text: Come back to me when you have freed my clerks and I will pay you well.

completion.speaker: Tessik
completion.text:
You are truly a hero! My sincere thanks.

As you were saving my clerks down below, the Captain stopped by, asking after you. He's waiting at the Lower Gate -- south of here.

Before you leave, here is some gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Slay or banish all the beasts in the vaults. Rescue the 4 trapped clerks.

variants.specifics: Kell Varn: Orlo, a trapper, asks the player to learn what became of his brother in the White Wolves' den

offer.speaker: Orlo
offer.text:
Mangy brutes! The White Wolves have come down off the heights and made a terror of the whole pass!

I am Master Trapper Orlo. I am looking for my brother. I fear he has strayed into a nearby Wolf Den.

If you could find out what happened and bring me word, I would be willing to teach you the trade. Come with me and I will point out the cursed Wolf Den above his cabin.

reminder.speaker: Orlo
reminder.text: Any sign of my brother? Oh no, I fear he is gone.

completion.speaker: Orlo
completion.text:
My brother's cap! Bad luck must have caught up with him.

You have shown the wolves could not stop you. Maybe you would make a fine trapper. Hmmm... Yes.

Follow me to the cabin. Whenever you like, take the Bow off the rack. We have plenty of trapping ahead of us up there.

journal.text: Learn the fate of Orlo's brother.

variants.specifics: Ashkar: Gorm, a lift-keeper, had his best helmet stolen by Goblins while napping and wants it back.

offer.speaker: Gorm
offer.text:
Sorry, mate, the ore lift is jammed! Only way down to the lower forge is the old cart tunnel, through the Goblin warren. But, if you go that way, mate, keep your guard up! The Goblins stole my best helmet while I was napping!

If you bring it back, I'll give you a damn fine spell book.

reminder.speaker: Gorm
reminder.text: Did you find my helmet yet?

completion.speaker: Gorm
completion.text: My helmet! I had given it up for lost! I'm eternally grateful. Here's the book, as promised.

journal.text: Find the helmet stolen from Gorm by the Goblins and bring it back to him.

variants.specifics: Tolmar Cross: Bessa Tuck, a cider brewer, wants a bear out of the shed by her hop yard; the hornets sting everyone. She pays in a ferry pass.

offer.speaker: Bessa Tuck
offer.text:
Good! My family brews the finest cider in Tolmar Cross. Unfortunately, a foul great bear has moved into the shed near our hop yard. He has stirred up the hornets and now they sting anyone who goes into the yard.

Go and kill the bear, then come back and I'll sign your ferry pass.

Here, take this iron key, it opens the yard gate.

reminder.speaker: Bessa Tuck
reminder.text: Don't fret, one old bear is no great threat. Come back when it's been put down.

completion.speaker: Bessa Tuck
completion.text:
Excellent! The bear is dead.

Here is your ferry pass. Show it to Ibb and he'll put you on the ferry. Good luck!

journal.text: Kill the Bear troubling Tuck's hop yard.

variants.specifics: Tosk: Tamsin, a farmer, lost her horses to Ogres who broke into her barn, and pays to have them chased off.

offer.speaker: Tamsin
offer.text:
My luck has been rotten of late. Two weeks ago, Ogres broke into the barn and carried off my horses.

I don't expect I'll see them again, but I'd love to see those brutes run out of the valley.

There's coin for anyone who chases them off.

reminder.speaker: Tamsin
reminder.text: Have those brutes left my barn yet?

completion.speaker: Tamsin
completion.text:
So the Ogres have been chased off! Well done, lad! We shall all rest easier knowing those brutes won't be stomping through our barley!

Now take your reward... 90 in gold! You're always welcome at Tamsin's!

journal.text: Drive off the Ogres that raided Tamsin's barn.
